newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks lose 2.16 pct as selling continues.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks lose 2.16 pct as selling continues.

text.p: Dhaka shares closed lower as both retail investors and dealers maintained selling pressure to evade further losses in the falling market, brokers said.

The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) benchmark index lost 50.14 points or 2.16 percent at 2,269 on a turnover of 28.5 million taka. "I don't see any prospect of immediate recovery. Proposed agitation by kerb market traders may further shake the market," said one broker. Kerb market traders have threatened to stop floor trade from Sunday if prices continue to fall. IDLC lost 254 taka to 4,037 and Aziz Pipes shed 184 to 3,514.
